description: Prepare a featured placement for a company's own affiliate program. Give the program's page; returns whether the program is listed (and in which category: featuring is only in that one), the likeliest category from the company's website if it is not listed (pass category to choose another), a draft card from the company's website (name up to 32 characters, one line up to 90, no figures and no web addresses), and a link where the person checks it and pays. Nothing is booked or charged until they pay there. Never pay, and never enter payment details: pass the link to the person.

program_url.description: The company's own affiliate, referral or partner program page.
